canada.title: Doctors said she wouldn't reach adulthood. This Londoner just turned 40
canada.summary: When Hibaq Abdi was diagnosed with spinal muscular atrophy as a child, doctors didn't expect her to live past her teenage years. At 12, she felt she was living on borrowed time. But on Monday, the Londoner celebrated her 40th birthday.

canada.title: New Brunswick's giant duck 'out in the middle of nowhere'
canada.summary: Deep in the woods, a giant duck made of rock presides over about two dozen small rock ducks and several genuine rubber ducks. The flock delights the many who travel by offroad vehicle toward the remote home of Brad and Lorrie Swan, the couple who started it all.

canada.title: Quispamsis Para cyclist Alexandre Hayward wins elimination race bronze at world championships

lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Saskatchewan is welcoming a business tax incentive announced in the recent federal budget, The Canadian Press reports.
Trump replaces Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller as chief of staff after GOP’s midterm defeat, The Associated Press reports.

Prime Minister Mark Carney says his government welcomes "any moves" to restore free trade between Canada and the United States as officials south of the border push to end the trade war, The Canadian Press reports.
Tesla’s Cybertruck, the hulking, stainless-steel pickup that inspired devotion and derision with its science-fiction looks, will cease production next year, The Associated Press reports.
In New Zealand, people cast a party vote as well as an electorate vote in a general election, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
